links.outcome: Sensitivity of AI triage for emergency and urgent cases versus consultant gold standard
links.effect: 100% sensitivity for emergency safety and 92.3% sensitivity for urgent cases; 74.3% overall accuracy.
links.quote: The system achieved a 74.3% accuracy and 100% sensitivity for emergency safety and 92.3% sensitivity for urgent cases.

screen.reason: Prospective cohort study evaluating the clinical diagnostic accuracy and triage safety of an AI clinical decision support tool (LabTest Checker) used by patients to interpret laboratory results compared to expert clinician recommendations.
